comment: Read from src/FrequencyAnalyzer.cpp at commit fb01326, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.11.1, alongside docs/Cella_Manual.md written for 2.11.0. All four parameters are declared with no widget of their own (FrequencyAnalyzer.cpp:112 to 117 against the widget's addParam calls, of which there are none), so none has a census position and no click can reach them; they appear as sliders on the context menu at FrequencyAnalyzer.cpp:895 to 898. The band centres and the four slider ranges are the constants at FrequencyAnalyzer.cpp:20 to 31, and they match the manual exactly.
